baseline_updates.rationale: Accepted baseline records the VS Code Control Center boundary: filesystem-only projection and prompt composer in the extension, Python DevWeave engine as authority, Codex Chat as mutation handoff, and no Git/version-control operations.

EVID-001.summary: Extension typecheck and production package build passed.

EVID-002.summary: Snapshot contract tests cover uninitialized, managed false/true, multiple and closed work, malformed/unsupported schema, legacy state, stale Wiki and missing hook; mutation diagnostics fail closed.

EVID-003.summary: Deterministic PromptComposer tests cover every ActionIntent, canonical CLI option ordering, public chat routing, gate warnings, read-only blocking, repo-relative target paths, absolute path and credential-like redaction; Node suite and typecheck pass.

EVID-004.summary: Typed Webview protocol round-trip/malformed-message tests, clipboard adapter seam, debounced workspace watchers, safe DevWeave file opener and production bundle pass; no command execution or repository write API is present in Extension runtime.

EVID-005.summary: Dashboard/Webview UI now exposes next safe action, G1/G2/G3 track, artifact trace, task board, verification command/evidence metadata, acceptance baseline/Wiki/waiver state, audit log, snapshot freshness, Wiki index-first rule and VS Code-token accessibility styling; multiple work selection is explicit.

EVID-006.summary: All ActionIntent categories are available from the Webview composer; action buttons now use previewAction, render full action/gate/target/warning/machine-command confirmation, and only confirmed copyAction reaches clipboard. Protocol parser, typecheck, unit suite and production package pass.

EVID-015.summary: 高風險獨立 code review：確認 Extension 只使用 workspace.fs read/stat/readDirectory 與 clipboard API；無 child_process、shell、repository write、Git、Codex execution 或 external network；Webview strict CSP、typed fail-closed protocol、repo-relative path/credential/raw-log sanitization、schema/legacy compatibility、bounded reads、watcher freshness warning、TreeView/Webview accessibility tokens 與 copy-only governance warning 均符合 approved design。Rollback 為停用或移除 vscode-extension，不需 state migration；command profiles 僅由 DevWeave engine 管理。

EVID-016.summary: Acceptance preparation cross-check completed: all AC-001..AC-014 have current source-bound passing evidence; all 9 tasks are completed; high-risk required profiles extension-typecheck, extension-tests, extension-package, extension-smoke and unit-tests have current passing command evidence; baseline target is declared and changed; Wiki affected_pages is empty with only the pre-existing overview placeholder warning. G3 remains pending explicit human approval.

gaps: wiki/overview.md 仍為 bootstrap placeholder，尚未有 source-bound runtime、dependency、operational 與 deployment knowledge；本 work item 需依 raw source 補足 Extension 整合邊界。

risk.rationale: 新增 TypeScript VS Code Extension、Webview UI、contract projection、Codex prompt composer 與多層測試；會引入新的 build/dependency surface，但所有 repository mutation 仍由既有 DevWeave engine、Codex Chat 與 guard 執行。

scope.rationale: 將 Extension Host、Webview、contract projection、prompt composer、測試與 package/build artifacts 限制在單一新增 subtree；既有 DevWeave engine、Wiki、baseline、hook 與產品 source 保持不變。

TASK-001.note: TypeScript/esbuild scaffold, contribution manifest, package scripts, CSP-ready asset layout, typecheck and production package all pass.

TASK-002.note: WorkspaceSnapshotReader and filesystem adapter now project project/work/baseline/Wiki/hook/skill metadata with bounded reads, legacy compatibility, stale diagnostics and fail-closed mutation state; eight contract tests pass.

TASK-003.note: Complete ActionIntent routing and PromptComposer canonicalization are implemented; all action previews are deterministic and sanitized, with approval/read-only diagnostics.

TASK-004.note: Host controller, TreeView, per-folder watcher debounce, clipboard adapter and fail-closed typed Webview protocol are implemented and packaged.

TASK-005.note: Dashboard/Webview delivers repository welcome, phase/gate track, next safe action, artifact/design/plan trace, Wiki-first knowledge, task board, verification/acceptance matrix and audit view with theme-token accessibility styling and explicit multi-work selection.

TASK-006.note: All ActionIntent categories are exposed through the composer and stage actions; unified previewAction → confirmation → copyAction interaction is implemented with target/gate/warning/machine-command detail.

TASK-007.note: Extension typecheck、13 項 contract/security tests 與既有 Python 62 tests 均通過；測試涵蓋 snapshot、prompt、protocol、preview-first、無 process/shell/write/network 邊界與既有 DevWeave regression。

TASK-008.note: README 已記錄安裝、typecheck/test/package/smoke、read-only 與 Codex Chat copy-only boundary；production bundle 與 VS Code 1.131.0 Extension Host activation smoke 均通過。

TASK-009.note: 已透過 DevWeave command set 註冊 extension-typecheck、extension-tests、extension-package（low/standard/high）與 extension-smoke（standard/high）；全部使用 repo-relative cwd，並以 command-bound evidence 驗證。
